versos.hebraico: מַשָּׂ֖א גֵּ֣יא חִזָּי֑וֹן מַה־לָּ֣ךְ אֵפ֔וֹא כִּֽי־עָלִ֥ית כֻּלָּ֖ךְ לַגַּגּֽוֹת׃

controles.web: The burden of the valley of vision. What ails you now, that you have all gone up to the housetops?
controles.kjv: The burden of the valley of vision. What aileth thee now, that thou art wholly gone up to the housetops?
controles.livre: Revelação sobre o vale da visão:O que há contigo, agora, para que tenhas subido toda aos terraços?

versos.hebraico: תְּשֻׁא֣וֹת׀ מְלֵאָ֗ה עִ֚יר הֽוֹמִיָּ֔ה קִרְיָ֖ה עַלִּיזָ֑ה חֲלָלַ֨יִךְ֙ לֹ֣א חַלְלֵי־חֶ֔רֶב וְלֹ֖א מֵתֵ֥י מִלְחָמָֽה׃

controles.web: You that are full of shouting, a tumultuous city, a joyous town; your slain are not slain with the sword, neither are they dead in battle.
controles.kjv: Thou that art full of stirs, a tumultuous city, a joyous city: thy slain men are not slain with the sword, nor dead in battle.
controles.livre: Tu cheia de barulhos, cidade tumultuada, cidade alegre! Teus mortos não morreram pela espada, nem morreram na guerra.

versos.hebraico: כָּל־קְצִינַ֥יִךְ נָֽדְדוּ־יַ֖חַד מִקֶּ֣שֶׁת אֻסָּ֑רוּ כָּל־נִמְצָאַ֨יִךְ֙ אֻסְּר֣וּ יַחְדָּ֔ו מֵרָח֖וֹק בָּרָֽחוּ׃

controles.web: All your rulers fled away together. They were bound by the archers. All who were found by you were bound together. They fled far away.
controles.kjv: All thy rulers are fled together, they are bound by the archers: all that are found in thee are bound together, which have fled from far.
controles.livre: Todos os teus líderes juntamente fugiram; foram presos sem nem usarem o arco; todos os teus que foram achados juntamente foram amarrados, ainda que tenham fugido para longe.

versos.hebraico: עַל־כֵּ֥ן אָמַ֛רְתִּי שְׁע֥וּ מִנִּ֖י אֲמָרֵ֣ר בַּבֶּ֑כִי אַל־תָּאִ֣יצוּ לְנַֽחֲמֵ֔נִי עַל־שֹׁ֖ד בַּת־עַמִּֽי׃

controles.web: Therefore I said, “Look away from me. I will weep bitterly. Don’t labor to comfort me for the destruction of the daughter of my people.
controles.kjv: Therefore said I, Look away from me; I will weep bitterly, labour not to comfort me, because of the spoiling of the daughter of my people.
controles.livre: Por isso eu disse: Desviai vossa vista de mim, pois chorarei amargamente; não insistais em me consolar pela destruição da filha do meu povo.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֣י יוֹם֩ מְהוּמָ֨ה וּמְבוּסָ֜ה וּמְבוּכָ֗ה לַֽאדֹנָ֧י יְהוִ֛ה צְבָא֖וֹת בְּגֵ֣יא חִזָּי֑וֹן מְקַרְקַ֥ר קִ֖ר וְשׁ֥וֹעַ אֶל־הָהָֽר׃

controles.web: For it is a day of confusion, and of treading down, and of perplexity, from the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, in the valley of vision; a breaking down of the walls, and a crying to the mountains.”
controles.kjv: For it is a day of trouble, and of treading down, and of perplexity by the Lord God of hosts in the valley of vision, breaking down the walls, and of crying to the mountains.
controles.livre: Pois foi dia de alvoroço, de atropelamento, e de confusão, proveniente do Senhor DEUS dos exércitos, no vale da visão; dia de muros serem derrubados, e de gritarem ao monte.

versos.hebraico: וְעֵילָם֙ נָשָׂ֣א אַשְׁפָּ֔ה בְּרֶ֥כֶב אָדָ֖ם פָּֽרָשִׁ֑ים וְקִ֥יר עֵרָ֖ה מָגֵֽן׃

controles.web: Elam carried his quiver, with chariots of men and horsemen; and Kir uncovered the shield.
controles.kjv: And Elam bare the quiver with chariots of men and horsemen, and Kir uncovered the shield.
controles.livre: E Elão tomou a aljava, e houve homens em carruagens, e cavaleiros. Quir descobriu os escudos.

versos.hebraico: וַיְהִ֥י מִבְחַר־עֲמָקַ֖יִךְ מָ֣לְאוּ רָ֑כֶב וְהַפָּ֣רָשִׁ֔ים שֹׁ֖ת שָׁ֥תוּ הַשָּֽׁעְרָה׃

controles.web: Your choicest valleys were full of chariots, and the horsemen set themselves in array at the gate.
controles.kjv: And it shall come to pass, that thy choicest valleys shall be full of chariots, and the horsemen shall set themselves in array at the gate.
controles.livre: E foi que teus melhores vales se encheram de carruagens de guerra; e cavaleiros se puseram em posição de ataque junto ao portão.

versos.hebraico: וַיְגַ֕ל אֵ֖ת מָסַ֣ךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה וַתַּבֵּט֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא אֶל־נֶ֖שֶׁק בֵּ֥ית הַיָּֽעַר׃

controles.web: He took away the covering of Judah; and you looked in that day to the armor in the house of the forest.
controles.kjv: And he discovered the covering of Judah, and thou didst look in that day to the armour of the house of the forest.
controles.livre: E tiraram a cobertura de Judá; e naquele dia olhastes para as armas da casa do bosque.

versos.hebraico: וְאֵ֨ת בְּקִיעֵ֧י עִיר־דָּוִ֛ד רְאִיתֶ֖ם כִּי־רָ֑בּוּ וַֽתְּקַבְּצ֔וּ אֶת־מֵ֥י הַבְּרֵכָ֖ה הַתַּחְתּוֹנָֽה׃

controles.web: You saw the breaches of the city of David, that they were many; and you gathered together the waters of the lower pool.
controles.kjv: Ye have seen also the breaches of the city of David, that they are many: and ye gathered together the waters of the lower pool.
controles.livre: E vistes as brechas dos muros da cidade de Davi, que eram muitas; e ajuntastes águas no tanque de baixo.

versos.hebraico: וְאֶת־בָּתֵּ֥י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם סְפַרְתֶּ֑ם וַתִּתְֿצוּ֙ הַבָּ֣תִּ֔ים לְבַצֵּ֖ר הַחוֹמָֽה׃

controles.web: You numbered the houses of Jerusalem, and you broke down the houses to fortify the wall.
controles.kjv: And ye have numbered the houses of Jerusalem, and the houses have ye broken down to fortify the wall.
controles.livre: Também contastes as casas de Jerusalém; e derrubastes casas para fortalecer os muros.

versos.hebraico: וּמִקְוָ֣ה׀ עֲשִׂיתֶ֗ם בֵּ֚ין הַחֹ֣מֹתַ֔יִם לְמֵ֖י הַבְּרֵכָ֣ה הַיְשָׁנָ֑ה וְלֹ֤א הִבַּטְתֶּם֙ אֶל־עֹשֶׂ֔יהָ וְיֹצְרָ֥הּ מֵֽרָח֖וֹק לֹ֥א רְאִיתֶֽם׃

controles.web: You also made a reservoir between the two walls for the water of the old pool. But you didn’t look to him who had done this, neither did you have respect for him who purposed it long ago.
controles.kjv: Ye made also a ditch between the two walls for the water of the old pool: but ye have not looked unto the maker thereof, neither had respect unto him that fashioned it long ago.
controles.livre: Fizestes também um reservatório entre os dois muros para as águas do tanque velho; porém não destes atenção para aquele que fez estas coisas, nem olhastes para aquele que as formou  desde a antiguidade.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּקְרָ֗א אֲדֹנָ֧י יְהוִ֛ה צְבָא֖וֹת בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֑וּא לִבְכִי֙ וּלְמִסְפֵּ֔ד וּלְקָרְחָ֖ה וְלַחֲגֹ֥ר שָֽׂק׃

controles.web: In that day, the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, called to weeping, and to mourning, and to baldness, and to dressing in sackcloth:
controles.kjv: And in that day did the Lord God of hosts call to weeping, and to mourning, and to baldness, and to girding with sackcloth:
controles.livre: E naquele dia o Senhor DEUS dos exércitos chamou ao choro, ao lamento, ao raspar de cabelos, e ao vestir de saco.

versos.hebraico: וְהִנֵּ֣ה׀ שָׂשׂ֣וֹן וְשִׂמְחָ֗ה הָרֹ֤ג׀ בָּקָר֙ וְשָׁחֹ֣ט צֹ֔אן אָכֹ֥ל בָּשָׂ֖ר וְשָׁת֣וֹת יָ֑יִן אָכ֣וֹל וְשָׁת֔וֹ כִּ֥י מָחָ֖ר נָמֽוּת׃

controles.web: and behold, joy and gladness, killing cattle and killing sheep, eating flesh and drinking wine: “Let us eat and drink, for tomorrow we will die.”
controles.kjv: And behold joy and gladness, slaying oxen, and killing sheep, eating flesh, and drinking wine: let us eat and drink; for to morrow we shall die.
controles.livre: E eis aqui alegria e festejo, matando vacas e degolando ovelhas, comendo carne, bebendo vinho, e dizendo : Comamos e bebamos, porque amanhã morreremos!

versos.hebraico: וְנִגְלָ֥ה בְאָזְנָ֖י יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת אִם־יְ֠כֻפַּר הֶעָוֺ֨ן הַזֶּ֤ה לָכֶם֙ עַד־תְּמֻת֔וּן אָמַ֛ר אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִ֖ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃פ

controles.web: Yahweh of Armies revealed himself in my ears, “Surely this iniquity will not be forgiven you until you die,” says the Lord, Yahweh of Armies.
controles.kjv: And it was revealed in mine ears by the Lord of hosts, Surely this iniquity shall not be purged from you till ye die, saith the Lord God of hosts.
controles.livre: Mas o SENHOR dos exércitos se revelou a meus ouvidos, dizendo : Certamente esta maldade não vos será perdoada até que morrais, diz o Senhor DEUS dos exércitos.

versos.hebraico: כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֛ר אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִ֖ה צְבָא֑וֹת לֶךְ־בֹּא֙ אֶל־הַסֹּכֵ֣ן הַזֶּ֔ה עַל־שֶׁבְנָ֖א אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל־הַבָּֽיִת׃

controles.web: Thus says the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, “Go, get yourself to this treasurer, even to Shebna, who is over the house, and say,
controles.kjv: Thus saith the Lord God of hosts, Go, get thee unto this treasurer, even unto Shebna, which is over the house, and say,
controles.livre: Assim disse o Senhor DEUS dos exércitos: Vai, visita este mordomo, Sebna, que administra a casa real ,

versos.hebraico: מַה־לְּךָ֥ פֹה֙ וּמִ֣י לְךָ֣ פֹ֔ה כִּֽי־חָצַ֧בְתָּ לְּךָ֛ פֹּ֖ה קָ֑בֶר חֹצְבִ֤י מָרוֹם֙ קִבְר֔וֹ חֹקְקִ֥י בַסֶּ֖לַע מִשְׁכָּ֥ן לֽוֹ׃

controles.web: ‘What are you doing here? Who has you here, that you have dug out a tomb here?’ Cutting himself out a tomb on high, chiseling a habitation for himself in the rock!”
controles.kjv: What hast thou here? and whom hast thou here, that thou hast hewed thee out a sepulchre here, as he that heweth him out a sepulchre on high, and that graveth an habitation for himself in a rock?
controles.livre: E dize-lhe : O que é que tens aqui? Ou quem tu tens aqui, que te dá direito a cavares aqui tua sepultura, como quem cava em lugar alto sua sepultura, e talha na rocha morada para si?

versos.hebraico: הִנֵּ֤ה יְהוָה֙ מְטַלְטֶלְךָ֔ טַלְטֵלָ֖ה גָּ֑בֶר וְעֹטְךָ֖ עָטֹֽה׃

controles.web: Behold, Yahweh will overcome you and hurl you away violently. Yes, he will grasp you firmly.
controles.kjv: Behold, the Lord will carry thee away with a mighty captivity, and will surely cover thee.
controles.livre: Eis que o SENHOR te lançará fora, ó homem,  e te agarrará!

versos.hebraico: צָנ֤וֹף יִצְנָפְךָ֙ צְנֵפָ֔ה כַּדּ֕וּר אֶל־אֶ֖רֶץ רַחֲבַ֣ת יָדָ֑יִם שָׁ֣מָּה תָמ֗וּת וְשָׁ֨מָּה֙ מַרְכְּב֣וֹת כְּבוֹדֶ֔ךָ קְל֖וֹן בֵּ֥ית אֲדֹנֶֽיךָ׃

controles.web: He will surely wind you around and around, and throw you like a ball into a large country. There you will die, and there the chariots of your glory will be, you shame of your lord’s house.
controles.kjv: He will surely violently turn and toss thee like a ball into a large country: there shalt thou die, and there the chariots of thy glory shall be the shame of thy lord’s house.
controles.livre: Certamente ele te lançará rodando, como uma bola numa terra larga e espaçosa. Ali morrerás, e ali estarão tuas gloriosas carruagens, para desonra da casa do teu senhor.

versos.hebraico: וַהֲדַפְתִּ֖יךָ מִמַּצָּבֶ֑ךָ וּמִמַּעֲמָֽדְךָ֖ יֶהֶרְסֶֽךָ׃

controles.web: I will thrust you from your office. You will be pulled down from your station.
controles.kjv: And I will drive thee from thy station, and from thy state shall he pull thee down.
controles.livre: E te removerei de tua posição, e te arrancarei de teu assento.

versos.hebraico: וְהָיָ֖ה בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֑וּא וְקָרָ֣אתִי לְעַבְדִּ֔י לְאֶלְיָקִ֖ים בֶּן־חִלְקִיָּֽהוּ׃

controles.web: It will happen in that day that I will call my servant Eliakim the son of Hilkiah,
controles.kjv: And it shall come to pass in that day, that I will call my servant Eliakim the son of Hilkiah:
controles.livre: E será naquele dia, que chamarei a meu servo Eliaquim, filho de Hilquias.

versos.hebraico: וְהִלְבַּשְׁתִּ֣יו כֻּתָּנְתֶּ֗ךָ וְאַבְנֵֽטְךָ֙ אֲחַזְּקֶ֔נּוּ וּמֶֽמְשֶׁלְתְּךָ֖ אֶתֵּ֣ן בְּיָד֑וֹ וְהָיָ֥ה לְאָ֛ב לְיוֹשֵׁ֥ב יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם וּלְבֵ֥ית יְהוּדָֽה׃

controles.web: and I will clothe him with your robe, and strengthen him with your belt. I will commit your government into his hand; and he will be a father to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and to the house of Judah.
controles.kjv: And I will clothe him with thy robe, and strengthen him with thy girdle, and I will commit thy government into his hand: and he shall be a father to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and to the house of Judah.
controles.livre: E eu o vestirei com tua túnica, e porei nele o teu cinto, e entregarei teu governo nas mãos dele, e ele será como um pai aos moradores de Jerusalém e à casa de Judá.

versos.hebraico: וְנָתַתִּ֛י מַפְתֵּ֥חַ בֵּית־דָּוִ֖ד עַל־שִׁכְמ֑וֹ וּפָתַח֙ וְאֵ֣ין סֹגֵ֔ר וְסָגַ֖ר וְאֵ֥ין פֹּתֵֽחַ׃

controles.web: I will lay the key of the house of David on his shoulder. He will open, and no one will shut. He will shut, and no one will open.
controles.kjv: And the key of the house of David will I lay upon his shoulder; so he shall open, and none shall shut; and he shall shut, and none shall open.
controles.livre: E porei a chave da casa de Davi sobre seu ombro; quando ele abrir, e ninguém fechará; e quando ele fechar, ninguém abrirá.

versos.hebraico: וּתְקַעְתִּ֥יו יָתֵ֖ד בְּמָק֣וֹם נֶאֱמָ֑ן וְהָיָ֛ה לְכִסֵּ֥א כָב֖וֹד לְבֵ֥ית אָבִֽיו׃

controles.web: I will fasten him like a nail in a sure place. He will be for a throne of glory to his father’s house.
controles.kjv: And I will fasten him as a nail in a sure place; and he shall be for a glorious throne to his father’s house.
controles.livre: E eu o fincarei como a um prego em um lugar firme; e ele será um trono de honra à casa de seu pai.

versos.hebraico: וְתָל֨וּ עָלָ֜יו כֹּ֣ל׀ כְּב֣וֹד בֵּית־אָבִ֗יו הַצֶּֽאֱצָאִים֙ וְהַצְּפִע֔וֹת כֹּ֖ל כְּלֵ֣י הַקָּטָ֑ן מִכְּלֵי֙ הָֽאַגָּנ֔וֹת וְעַ֖ד כָּל־כְּלֵ֥י הַנְּבָלִֽים׃

controles.web: They will hang on him all the glory of his father’s house, the offspring and the issue, every small vessel, from the cups even to all the pitchers.
controles.kjv: And they shall hang upon him all the glory of his father’s house, the offspring and the issue, all vessels of small quantity, from the vessels of cups, even to all the vessels of flagons.
controles.livre: E nele pendurarão toda a honra da casa de seu pai, dos renovos e dos descendentes, todos as vasilhas menores; desde as vasilhas de taças, até todas as vasilhas de jarros.

versos.hebraico: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא נְאֻם֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת תָּמוּשׁ֙ הַיָּתֵ֔ד הַתְּקוּעָ֖ה בְּמָק֣וֹם נֶאֱמָ֑ן וְנִגְדְּעָ֣ה וְנָפְלָ֗ה וְנִכְרַת֙ הַמַּשָּׂ֣א אֲשֶׁר־עָלֶ֔יהָ כִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה דִּבֵּֽר׃ס

controles.web: “In that day,” says Yahweh of Armies, “the nail that was fastened in a sure place will give way. It will be cut down, and fall. The burden that was on it will be cut off, for Yahweh has spoken it.”
controles.kjv: In that day, saith the Lord of hosts, shall the nail that is fastened in the sure place be removed, and be cut down, and fall; and the burden that was upon it shall be cut off: for the Lord hath spoken it.
controles.livre: Naquele dia, - diz o SENHOR dos exércitos, - o prego fincado em lugar firme será tirado; e será cortado, e cairá; e a carga que nele está será cortada; porque assim o SENHOR disse.
